scope: analysisd json_extended remaining overflows, csyslogd, custom_output, AR scripts, agentlessd, logcollector, os_maild headers, cleanevent/decoders, accumulator/geoip/compiled_rules

findings.title: match_regex unbounded totalResults heap OOB write past results[MAX_MATCHES]
findings.description: match_regex increments totalResults for every regex capture without checking totalResults < MAX_MATCHES (10). Eleven or more {Tag: values} matches in a rootcheck full_log write through results[10+], which were never allocated. Distinct from the known 30-byte-per-slot sprintf overflow.
findings.impact: Heap corruption in ossec-analysisd: DoS of alerting/AR/mail/integrations; plausible code execution as ossec.
findings.attack_path: 1) jsonout_output enabled (install.sh default yes). 2) Registered/compromised agent emits rootcheck alert whose full_log contains >=11 {name: values} tokens. 3) Rule group includes rootcheck. 4) Eventinfo_to_jsonstr -> W_ParseJSON -> W_JSON_ParseRootcheck -> match_regex. 5) Eleventh capture writes results[10].
evidence: Local replica: 12 {pci_dss_N: 1.N} tokens trigger results[10] write
findings.remediation: Guard totalResults < MAX_MATCHES before sprintf; use snprintf(..., MAX_STRING_LESS, ...); truncate or stop after MAX_MATCHES captures.

findings.title: W_JSON_ParseRootcheck fullog[1024] strncpy without NUL termination
findings.description: strncpy(fullog, lf->full_log, MAX_STRING) leaves fullog unterminated when full_log length >= 1024. match_regex/regexec then reads past the stack buffer. Distinct from the excluded hostname/location strncpy+str_cut bug.
findings.impact: Stack over-read / undefined behavior in analysisd; typically crash (DoS) on long rootcheck JSON encoding. Agent messages may be up to OS_MAXSTR (6144).
findings.attack_path: 1) jsonout_output enabled. 2) Rootcheck alert with attacker-controlled full_log >= 1024 bytes. 3) W_JSON_ParseRootcheck copies without NUL. 4) regexec walks past fullog on the stack.
evidence: Local replica: poisoned 1024-byte fullog after strncpy of 2000-byte source has no NUL; scan continues past 1024
findings.remediation: Set fullog[MAX_STRING-1] = '\0' after strncpy, or snprintf(fullog, sizeof(fullog), "%s", lf->full_log).
